brief:
An Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed a surgeon, a child, and multiple patients, according to Middle East Eye. The attack struck the facility's intensive care and surgical wards, forcing hospital administrators to suspend operations.

The strike damaged critical sections of the hospital, which serves as a major medical facility in southern Gaza. Hospital staff accounts indicate the strike caused significant casualties among both patients receiving treatment and medical personnel on duty.
